# Deb8er — Global MUN & Debate Platform

> Deb8er is a global online platform for MUN and debate practice, open to students ages 10-18. Build debate skills, compete in Model UN conferences, earn awards, and climb the leaderboard.

## About

Deb8er makes debating and Model UN accessible, fun, and gamified for students worldwide. Students earn gems through conference participation, awards, and lesson completion. The platform features a weekly resetting leaderboard, achievement badges, and structured lessons covering public speaking, research, and parliamentary procedure.
